title: Moving the strictness flips the same pair between hit and miss
goal: For {{castBrand}}, {{castOwner}} has to choose how close a prompt must be before {{castKey}} reuses an answer.
obstacle: Too loose and {{castApp}} may get a near answer to a different question; too strict and nothing is saved.
control: The strictness is a per-key setting. The same pair of prompts scores the same each time; at a low strictness it is a hit and at a high one it is a miss. A score equal to the strictness is a hit.
